## R1: Parse numbers
As a calc user, I want to turn text into numbers, so that I can calculate with user input.
- R1.1 WHEN parse(s) is called with a numeric string THE SYSTEM SHALL return that number
- R1.2 IF parse(s) is called with an empty string (or only spaces) THEN THE SYSTEM SHALL throw a TypeError with the message "empty input"

# Design

`parse.js` exports `parse(s)`. It trims `s`; an empty result throws `TypeError('empty input')` (R1.2), because `Number('')` is 0, which would silently turn no input into a zero.

spec#2.text: Revised: R1.2 makes empty input (and only spaces) a TypeError instead of Number('') === 0.

build.text: Implemented parse() for R1.1 and R1.2, with a test for each.
